# Grill With Docs

## What it does

Align a fuzzy idea and record decisions.

## When to reach for it

A fuzzy request has unresolved product, domain, ownership, or scope decisions.

## Where it fits

First in the workflow chain. It turns an idea into a shared vocabulary and a bounded destination for `$to-spec`. The catalog stage is `alignment`. Previous stages: None.

## Prerequisites

- No external tool dependency is declared.

## It is working if

- Obvious decisions are inferred and only consequential forks reach the user.
- Settled terms, scope, and open questions are written down for the spec stage.

## Invocation

Use `$grill-with-docs` when you want this skill explicitly. It is explicit-only.
